fixture_setup.repository: Use test/runtime-fake.mjs harbor with tests/place-order.json and its actual source capture; synthetic identities only. Add storyTest(repo, second) only in mixed-scope cases.
fixture_setup.wire: Use existing fakeRuntime POST/GET spies and fake.lint per-test/program admission. Attach complete v1 reports under result.capabilities and/or the legacy report.lint.tests entry as each case states. Echo the actual request IDs and lint command; default confirmed engine_sha is the build in report_template. Never accept a fixture as proof of live engine behavior.
fixture_setup.source: Construct each fake report source natively from exact captured effective sources: hash the selected scenario bytes and each selected returned file. Keep the server closure digest opaque: use the fixed synthetic 64-hex value below. This fixture is not a parser/projection proof. Compare actual uploaded archive bytes to capture; never take source data from an expected output or hash archive bytes as a closure.
fixture_setup.mutations: Each named replacement below changes fake transport input before the real public function runs. It is not a final classification argument. Supply sourceFiles only from actual captured bytes for native pure calls. Unknown build/version reports use aggregate and all row verdicts unknown with reason engine-build-unknown. Incomplete ordinary reports use unknown/analysis-unavailable rows. source:null is complete:false with unknown analysis; keep concrete mode/binding/source blockers only when the delivered contract permits them. Deliberately malformed/conflicting report cases are the named exceptions; never accidentally present an inconsistent report as a valid server state.
fixture_setup.effects: Snapshot approval files and behavioral evidence records before each command. Observe actual requests, streams, current/saved source and state; no model, resource or live service is used.

criteria.text: `pdd lint place-order` shows the selected Story and test, each operation and edge, its source location, exact server verdict and reason, and labelled client owner advice, without model work or product resource effects.
The view keeps supported, unsupported-capability, missing-binding, invalid-source and unknown distinct, and keeps two edges to the same target and repeated steps separate.

The view associates the report with the captured scenario and effective file bytes, the confirmed job build and its capability version; a known disagreement is unknown compatibility with a visible client association problem.
An absent, malformed, conflicting or incomplete selected report never looks ready; a concrete reported blocker remains visible when coverage is incomplete.
Unrelated inventory problems and incomplete reports for other tests stay visible without changing an independently admitted selected test.

Configured build metadata does not prove the installed engine, a host profile, physical observations or business behavior; absent evidence stays unknown or unproved, and no missing fixture fact is filled from an expected result.
Text and JSON keep the same selected facts and remove tokens, host paths and unsafe text; preflight zero-call facts never replace unknown paid-job usage.

cases.given: Complete own passed lint; matching captured source/build; deliver once with top-level capabilities and once legacy-only. Call outcomeFor and projectAnswer with actual sourceFiles, then runCheck lint text and JSON.
cases.required_observation: All views retain reported supported and association matched; lint exit 0; selected path, operation, modes, scenario/files/closure hashes, build and capability version agree. Label owner/next step as client advice. Exactly one lint POST, zero check/Try POSTs, zero product effects.

cases.given: Five independent terminal answers: supported/supported ordinary operation; unsupported-capability/retained-mutation-unsupported retained-mutation operation; missing-binding/binding-missing resource edge with binding_kind missing; invalid-source/source-admission-refused operation; unknown/requirement-uninspectable uninspectable operation. Keep source/build matching.
cases.required_observation: Each exact verdict/reason survives. Blockers exit 4; terminal unknown exits 5. The missing binding is an edge with full resource_operation identity, not an operation with binding_kind missing. Do not infer these features from prose.

cases.given: Add two internal edges with distinct edge_id and call_operation to the same declared target operation, with binding_kind internal; repeat the two operations and both edges in a second authored step with a different effective resource mode. Keep the report complete and identities unique.
cases.required_observation: The view keeps all operation and edge rows in server order; neither common target nor shared node name collapses distinct step/edge identities. Keep target path/operation and each effective mode.

cases.given: From matching input, separately change one scenario byte, one returned effective file digest, report engine_build versus answer.engine_sha, capability version versus its full build, remove sourceFiles, remove source, and use literal unknown build/version. Do not modify expected values.
cases.required_observation: Each known disagreement gives client association mismatch and state unknown, without rewriting reported verdict or inventing a server reason. Missing association facts give unknown. Complete known source/build match remains matched; archive and closure digests are never compared.

cases.given: Separately omit capabilities, supply unknown schema, conflicting top/legacy reports, duplicate operation identity, complete:false with unknown analysis-unavailable rows, and incomplete report retaining an unsupported-capability/runtime-mode-unsupported blocker.
cases.required_observation: First five unavailable/incomplete cases never display ready and end not_run/5. The incomplete concrete blocker remains reported and refused/4; selected completeness false stays visible. No empty-list inference of support.

cases.given: Own supported complete report and normal own lint pass; global lint/capabilities_complete false for second test; unrelated refused prompt and inventory problem. Repeat with selected own refusal.
cases.required_observation: Own test remains passed; global flags, other-test gaps and diagnostics remain separately visible. Own refusal still refuses even with supported capabilities; capability support never overrides admission.

cases.given: A complete supported fixture binding and matched configured build; no installed-binary attestation, native profile, physical-observation mapping or supplementary fixture fact is supplied. A separate accept reply and raw call count are present.
cases.required_observation: Retain reported structural support; installed-engine, host/profile and physical-observation evidence remain unknown/unproved. No logical phase count or modeled-effect Boolean is invented. Missing fixture fact stays absent; no global proof gate is invented.

cases.given: Use synthetic control text, a fake redaction sentinel in diagnostic/selection text and host path /srv/private/source; separately project an already-submitted check with incomplete accounting and capability provider_calls/resource_calls 0.
cases.required_observation: Text and JSON remove unsafe text and host paths, retain safe relative location and exact identity/digest facts, and carry the same selected compatibility and labelled advice. Submitted check calls remain unknown; preflight zeros cannot manufacture usage or criterion passes.
